text: There are several ways to earn yield on Bitcoin. In our latest report with @xapobankapp , we examine the Bitcoin yield landscape in detail.

$BTC is rallying on less leverage. Price is up 35% from the August low, while coin-denominated open interest is down almost 20%. That puts open interest at its lowest since March, potentially making the rally less susceptible to leverage flushes.

$BTC has stalled under its heaviest supply cluster. More long-term holder coins sit at $84k–$85k than at any other price on the chart. Price needs to break through and hold above this level for the rally to continue.

Bitcoin trades near $84k after a week that closed about 4% higher. ETF inflows carried the gain while perpetual traders and profit-takers sold into it, and Monday's dip takes price back to the lower end of its range. https://glassno.de/4ACHe7s
Spot traders are turning to altcoins. Total spot volume now runs close to 4x Bitcoin's, the highest since September 2025. Demand for higher risk like this has often lined up with local tops in $BTC.
